t: You are standing where the Hindoostane Coffee House opened in 1810 at 34 George Street, as the Hindoostane Dinner and Hooka Smoking Club. It was an Indian restaurant, the first of its kind in the British Isles. Its founder was Sake Dean Mahomed, a former captain in the East India Company's Bengal Army, who also introduced Indian cuisine and shampoo baths to Europe. He was the first Indian to publish a book in English. The restaurant closed in 1833, when he became bankrupt.
